messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: triangular matrix solvers
parts:
The triangular matrix solvers look great.

Marcus took the view approach, which I
think is the right way to go for a clean
match with Eigen. We can worry about triangular
matrix types later.

I'll make sure to doc it that way.

The next issue is how we expose that in Stan.
Do we have a lower_triangular_solve and
an upper_triangular_solve or just go with one?

- Bob

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] triangular matrix solvers
parts:
I could go either way on the functions in Stan.  I don't expect them to see a lot of use in the modelling language to be honest.

Maybe to keep things as consistent as possible between the language and the C++ interface use mdivide_left_tri_lower/mdivide_left_tri_upper?  If we're worried about brevity we could change over to mldivide_lt/mldivide_ut but that's a bit opaque.

Cheers,
Marcus
